# Resource: yet_cloud_dns_zone

A domain whose records Cloud keeps.

-> **Note:** Point the domain's registrar at `nameservers`: the zone becomes active once they answer for it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "yet_cloud_dns_zone" "acme" {
  name = "acme.example.org"
}

# Where the registrar has to point.
output "nameservers" {
  value = yet_cloud_dns_zone.acme.nameservers
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The domain: `acme.example.org`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `nameservers` (List of String) Where the domain's registrar has to point.
- `status` (String) `pending` until its nameservers answer for it, `active` after.

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, with an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import):

```terraform
import {
  to = yet_cloud_dns_zone.acme
  id = "01J9Z8K3V7Q2M4N6P8R0S2T4V6"
}
```

With [`terraform import`](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import):

```shell
terraform import yet_cloud_dns_zone.acme 01J9Z8K3V7Q2M4N6P8R0S2T4V6
```
